items.source: Provides classes for advising chat clients.
items.translation: 提供用于建议聊天客户端的类。

items.source:
The Message interface represents a message that can be sent or received in a chat
application.
items.translation: Message 接口表示可以在聊天应用程序中发送或接收的消息。

items.source: The AbstractMessage class is an abstract implementation of the Message interface.
items.translation: AbstractMessage 类是 Message 接口的抽象实现。

items.source: Lets the generative know the content was generated as a response to the user.
items.translation: 让生成内容明确表明其是作为对用户请求的回应而生成的。

items.source: A message of the type 'system' passed as input.
items.translation: 输入的消息类型为“系统”。

items.source:
The ToolResponseMessage class represents a message with a function content in a chat
application.
items.translation: ToolResponseMessage 类表示聊天应用程序中包含函数内容的消息。

items.source:
A message of the type 'user' passed as input Messages with the user role are from the
end-user or developer.
items.translation: 类型为"user"的消息作为输入消息传递时，具有用户角色的消息来自最终用户或开发者。
